name: box-carousel

frames.best_why: Mid-turn it shows three photo faces at once, making the cube shape unmistakable.

tagline: A cube of photos spins face by face as you drag or tap.
summary: A 3D cube whose faces are photos; buttons, arrow keys or a drag rotate it a quarter turn to reveal the next image.
appearance: A rectangular photo floats in a dark stage, briefly showing the side faces of a cube as it turns. Two small pill buttons, Prev and Next, sit centred beneath it.
behaviour: Pressing Next or Prev, dragging the photo, or using the arrow keys rotates the cube ninety degrees on its vertical axis and snaps to the next picture; a drag springs back to its nearest face.
demo_content: Mountain sunrise, a red flower on a blue sky, horses in a field and other stock photos.
search_phrases: carousel you can drag to spin
gallery that turns like a box
use_when: Photos deserve a playful, tactile reveal and the page can spare a square stage.
avoid_when: Fixed pixel width and height props mean it will not scale with its container.
customise: Pass an items array of image or video sources plus width, height, rotation direction, drag and autoplay settings; the faces' styling needs a source edit.
weight_why: Only four media faces and motion values; no per-frame canvas or large scene.

a11y.note: Arrow keys rotate it and a live region announces the item, but the focus ring is removed and the describedby target is missing.

issues: Carousel points aria-describedby at an id that is never rendered.
polish_why: Crisp cube rotation and clean controls; the demo is a bare photo box with plain pills.
